definitions.gloss: to contract; to undertake; to take on (a job)
definitions.explanation: To formally agree to take responsibility for a task or project, especially construction, manufacturing, or other professional work, usually under a contract.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{請|う}け{負|お}った。
examples.english: We contracted to do the construction work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧{会社|がいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改修|かいしゅう}→改修：12924_kaishuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{請|う}け{負|お}った。
examples.english: A major construction company undertook the renovation of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{請|う}け{負|お}って⟦{生計|せいけい}→生計：13524_seikei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てている→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: I make a living by taking on translation work as a freelancer.

notes:
{請|う}け{負|お}う is a transitive godan verb (conjugation: {請|う}け{負|お}わない, {請|う}け{負|お}って, etc.).

ASPECT (ている):
{請|う}け{負|お}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates that someone currently has a contract or is in the process of carrying out contracted work.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{請|う}け{負|お}う (to contract for something)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{請|う}け{負|お}う (to contract for construction)
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{請|う}け{負|お}う (to take on a job)
- ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{請|う}け{負|お}う (to undertake operations)

RELATED WORDS:
The noun form is {請負|うけおい} (contract, contracting). A {請負|うけおい}⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧ is a contractor.
